It's easy to hold and simple to use.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 3 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Traveler's Spear}} Traveler's Spears are [[Weapon]]s utilized by travelers to defend themselves from wild [[Animal]]s. They are noted to be easy to hold and simple to use. They are commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Traveler's Spear: * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Mipha]] amiibo Being made of metal, Traveler's Spears will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], though they will not burn when exposed to a [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. Finally, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].
